orbit_transfer.general_identity: For an orbit [sigma], define T[sigma]=sum_(g in G) g sigma. It is independent of representative and d_i T=T d_i; hence boundary commutes. Projection p_* T=|G| id on the free simplicial chain group, including stabilizer multiplicities.
orbit_transfer.conclusion: |G| H_*(E/G) contained in image H_*(E); finite enumeration is illustrative, general chain identity supplies proof.

closed_restriction.origin: Independent reconstruction of K31-01 scans57–59; not a formal proof certificate from finite enumeration.
closed_restriction.injective_sheaf: On X=A²_Q let I=product_(x∈X) i_x*Q. Each factor is injective because stalk is exact and Q injective; products of injectives are injective. I(U) is all Q-valued functions on U, but i^-1I on a closed Y consists of ambient germs, not all functions on Y.
closed_restriction.nonflasque_example: Y=V(xy), p=(0,0). On Y−p the constant ambient germs0 and1 on the two disjoint branches form a section. A germ at p extending it would equal0 and1 on nonempty ambient opens. Those intersect because X is irreducible, a contradiction.
closed_restriction.nonacyclic_example: Y1=V(y), Y2=V(y−x²+1), Y=Y1∪Y2. Their reduced intersection is {a=(-1,0),b=(1,0)}. The closed-cover exact sequence0→I|Y→i1*(I|Y1)⊕i2*(I|Y2)→i12*(I|{a,b})→0 is stalkwise exact.
closed_restriction.H1_obstruction: The pair of ambient constant germs(0 at a,1 at b) is not a difference of global sections on Y1,Y2. Choose representatives f_i,a and f_i,b for a putative section on each irreducible Yi. Compatibility on Yi gives an ambient nonempty open on which f_i,a=f_i,b. The required difference is0 on an ambient open near a and1 on an ambient open near b. All finitely many ambient opens meet in irreducible X, yielding0=1. Hence the cokernel of the H0 difference map, and therefore H1(Y,I|Y), is nonzero. No flasqueness of the restrictions to Yi is needed.
closed_restriction.irreducible_surface: In X=A³_Q take Y=V(z) and X1=V(z−y(y−x²+1)). Both are irreducible affine planes; Z=X1∩Y is the two-curve example. Push the injective all-functions sheaf on X1 forward to X. Closed direct image preserves injectives (its left adjoint inverse image is exact) and is exact. Restriction to Y is the closed pushforward of its restriction to Z, giving the same nonzero H1.

pointwise_affine_bound.origin: New deduction comparing exact published ILO and SGA4 theorems, not a claim of the manuscript.
pointwise_affine_bound.inputs: ILO XVIII-B3.2.5: a strictly local regular noetherian R of dimension d≥2 with ℓ invertible and a principal affine U has cd_ℓU=2d−1. ILO XVIII-B4.1.2 gives cd_ℓFracR≤d. SGA4X2.4 gives the reverse, hence equality.
pointwise_affine_bound.deduction: For every point y∈U apply SGA4X2.4 to R_y: cd_ℓκ(y)+dimR_y≤cd_ℓFracR=d. Thus the proposed pointwise supremum is≤d<2d−1=cd_ℓU. All ℓ-invertibility hypotheses hold. If ℓ=2, strict henselianity and invertibility of2 give a root of T²+1, hence all residue fields are nonreal; this checks the real exception.
pointwise_affine_bound.limits: Depends on the existence theorem and its exact hypotheses, not a newly constructed explicit R; no numerical experiment certifies those inputs.
